Houston Astros staff and front office: Full story on the Astros' ongoing managerial search, which will involve longtime Houston nemesis Albert Pujols - www.nytimes.com/athletic/775...

Boston Red Sox staff and front office: Confirming reports that Kyle Hudson, former Red Sox third base coach, has been hired by the Tigers as their new first base coach for 2027, replacing Anthony Sanders.

Milwaukee Brewers staff and front office: The World Series champion Brewers have four players who landed among the three finalists for BBWAA awards: Brice Turang: NL MVP Jacob Misiorowski: NL Cy Young Trevor Megill: NL Relief Pitcher of the Year Pat Murphy: NL Manager of the Year www.mlb.com/brewers/news...
Isaac Paredes: The Astros exercised Isaac Paredes’ $13.35 million club option.

Houston Astros roster moves and needs: The Astros added reliever Roddery Muñoz and catcher César Salazar to the 40-man roster, made their trade for pitcher Evan Reifert official and outrighted Jake Meyers off the 40-man roster. Meyers will elect free agency. Houston’s 40-man roster is at 39 players.
Tatsuya Imai: Tatsuya Imai will exercise his $18 million player option and return to the Astros in 2027, source tells @theathletic.com. First: @jonheyman.bsky.social - www.nytimes.com/athletic/773...
Nelson Velázquez: The Astros announced they released Nelson Velázquez so he could pursue an opportunity with a club in Asia.
